title: Validate E170 unaligned source reads
changes: Add a full-manifest-union regression for unaligned halfword and word reads with altered in-memory ROM backing.
validation: Windows cross-build _l4hwj3q and Wine 8_1wpiix PASS: 5,459,217 halfword and 8,159,411 word offsets match original bytes via bus and native API on three mirrors, totaling 81,711,768 comparisons. Inputs protected, Wine drained and scratch removed.
limitations: Fully covered offsets only; mixed covered/uncovered reads beyond sampled boundaries, guest CPU instructions, timing, scenes, per-owner attribution and deferred platforms remain open. No performance measurements.
